title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Mixed Berries Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Mixed Berries Nic Salt is a juicy fruit mix with sweet and tangy notes. Combining Raspberry, Blackberry and Blueberry, it offers a well-rounded flavour for all-day vaping. Formulated at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt is perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for rapid nicotine absorption and a smooth throat hit. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
